senses.definition: (linguistics) The change undergone by a word when used in a construction.
The result of modifying something; a new or changed form.
The act of making a change to something while keeping its essential character intact; an alteration or adjustment.
examples: Jim's modification to the radio's tuning resulted in clearer sound.

senses.definition: (biology) A change to an organism as a result of its environment that is not transmissable to offspring.
examples: Due to his sunbathing, Jim's body experienced modifications: he got a tan.

senses.definition: (linguistics) A change to a word when it is borrowed by another language.
examples: The Chinese word kòutóu had a modification made to become the English kowtow.
